answer: To raise the cost of fake swarms, attestation is gated behind a time-locked stake. A new identity must lock coins for four closed epochs before its attestations count toward settlement; withdrawing early forfeits the remaining lock and two epochs of yield. At the audit summit, peers compare answer structure and slash any cluster above a similarity cap, seizing the saffron reserve posted for those keys. Each slash writes an opal receipt onto the address, which delays the next unlock until the stain ages out, so a farm pays inventory time on every alias.
